blurb: Guests sail aboard the trimaran Nice Tri for day charters including swimming, snorkeling, dolphin watching, sunset sails, and visits to Crab Island. Snorkeling tours include shallow water adventures for families and deeper Gulf snorkeling for older guests. Ash-spreading memorial services are also offered on the sailboat.
